market_summary: EURUSD and GBPUSD have pushed toward their respective session highs and Value Area Highs during the London session, but both lack volume expansion (RVOL < 1.0) and are hitting upper ATR resistance boundaries, warning against chasing longs into overhead supply. BTCUSD remains compressed below VWAP, EMA50, and POC within its session Value Area without clear catalyst volume. All three assets warrant a HOLD posture pending clear breakout confirmation or mean-reversion pullbacks.

signals.rationale: Evaluating 7-point confluence checklist: 1) VP context: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10774, VAH 1.10985) and above POC 1.10942, pushing directly against upper Value Area High boundary. 2) CVD: +5,564 (BULLISH) with positive slope (+3,454.47), aligning with the bullish push. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, active liquidity. 4) Trend/baseline: Price is well above VWAP (1.10853) and EMA50 (1.10886), indicating positive intraday momentum. 5) ATR band: Price is pressing directly against the upper ATR band (1.10986), stretched to volatility limits. 6) Volume/RVOL: RVOL is low at 0.879 (no yellow spike >2.0), signaling lack of breakout volume through resistance. 7) S/R: Testing Session High resistance at 1.10992 right at VAH without breakout volume confirmation. Buying directly into key overhead resistance without RVOL confirmation presents high risk of a fakeout; waiting for a clean breakout or pullback toward POC.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish / price holding above rising VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection / testing Session High and VAH at 1.10985-1.10992

signals.rationale: Evaluating 7-point confluence checklist: 1) VP context: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32593, VAH 1.32797) and slightly above POC 1.32738. 2) CVD: -1,471 (NEUTRAL) with flat slope, showing mild bearish divergence against the recent price push. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, active market. 4) Trend/baseline: Price is above VWAP (1.32664) and EMA50 (1.32698), showing mild upward bias. 5) ATR band: Price is consolidating near the upper ATR band (1.32808). 6) Volume/RVOL: RVOL is weak at 0.655 with no yellow confirmation bars. 7) S/R: Price is pinned just below Session High (1.32809) and VAH (1.32797). Lacking breakout volume and with neutral CVD divergence, entering long at the top of the range is unfavorable.

signals.rationale: Evaluating 7-point confluence checklist: 1) VP context: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 73377.88, VAH 73782.38) and below POC 73522.35. 2) CVD: -0.04 (BEARISH) with flat delta slope, indicating subdued selling pressure. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend/baseline: Price is trading below VWAP (73606.33) and EMA50 (73611.42), which are acting as overhead dynamic resistance. 5) ATR band: Price is mid-channel between EMA20 (73446.62) and lower ATR band (73100.20), reflecting compression. 6) Volume/RVOL: RVOL at 1.431 with 0 spikes > 2.0; lacks conviction. 7) S/R: Holding above minor support at 73386.80 and 73284.60, but capped beneath POC and VWAP. With price trapped mid-range between support and POC/VWAP, edge is low.
